bio.text: Robin Littau is the Republican candidate for California's 2nd Congressional District in 2026 and an elected member of the Enterprise Elementary School District board.
Littau served in the U.S. Coast Guard from 1997 to 2001 and attended Shasta College; according to the Ballotpedia candidate survey, service there was as a diesel mechanic.
According to the Ballotpedia candidate survey, Littau was born and raised in South Dakota, has lived in California for 28 years including 10 in Redding, and owns two small businesses.
